_comment.about: corporate/corporate/nextjs is the Next.js half of corporate_sdk, the company pages. Since 1.2.0 (Ray, 2026-09-11 20:44Z, of /about: "we have no way to get here and its so disconnected to the rest of the site") every page here - /about, /team, /legal, /legal/<id> - awaits base_sdk >= 1.47.0's resolveSiteFrame({plans: [], session, dataMode}) (components/custom/landing/site-frame.ts) and sits in base's SiteFrame (components/custom/site-frame.tsx: the home SDK's header with its registered menu, its theme and its footer - the sections it marked frame: true) when SiteFrameLayout.registered is true, and in this SDK's own CompanyFrame / LegalFrame otherwise, so a shell composed without a home landing renders exactly as 1.1.0 did; the home SDK opts in by marking its theme and footer sections, and this SDK never imports one. Also since 1.2.0 load-legal-doc.ts's loadLegalDoc(slug) mirrors base_sdk 1.45.0's listPublicTerms() rule per slug: the backend wins with an enabled document, and when it answers nothing for the slug the bundled data/legal/<slug>.md page is the document in any data mode that bundles the folder (bundledLegalDoc; a shell with no folder answers what it did), so the slugs the 1.45.0 index lists on a hybrid shell whose backend publishes nothing no longer 404 on their own page. Floors: base_sdk >= 1.47.0 (the site frame), base_sdk >= 1.45.0 (app/actions/base/legal.ts listing the bundled slugs the document page now answers). Since 1.1.0 (Ray, 2026-09-10 22:14Z: corporate_sdk owns the company pages - legal, about, team - as renderers, with content from the shell's data/ folder on local / hybrid shells) it installs app/about/page.tsx and app/team/page.tsx: /about renders the shell's data/about.md (base_sdk >= 1.35.0's readSiteData("about"), markdown parsed by components/custom/company/markdown-parser.ts and rendered as elements by markdown.tsx - a small safe subset, never HTML set from a string) and, under it, the home SDK's cards for the page through base_sdk >= 1.38.0's pageSectionsFor("about") (components/custom/landing/landing-page.ts; PageSectionMeta.page on page-sections.ts - Supacharge's founder card is lms_sdk 1.27.0's lms-founder-section.tsx), drawn by components/custom/company/company-sections.tsx with the PageSectionProps a landing section gets; /team renders data/team.json (readSiteData("team"): name, role, optional photo, optional links) as the card grid components/custom/company/team-grid.tsx plus pageSectionsFor("team"). Both sit in components/custom/company/company-frame.tsx (the host's PLATFORM_NAME linking home, the company links, base's FooterChromeRow with the Legal group) and take their titles from company-pages.ts (COMPANY_PAGES, the words About and Team - the only words this SDK owns here, as base owns Legal) through buildPageMetadata; with neither data nor a registered section each draws one neutral line (COMPANY_EMPTY_STATE) and still answers 200. The legal fallback: load-legal-doc.ts's loadLegalDoc / loadLegalIndex read data/legal/<slug>.md (siteLegalDocs) when hasSiteData("legal") and the shell is local or no tenant base URL resolves (resolveTenantBaseUrl); a hybrid shell with a backend keeps reading the backend. Floors: base_sdk >= 1.38.0 (landing-page.ts pageSectionsFor, page-sections.ts PageSectionMeta.page), >= 1.35.0 (lib/site-data/read-site-data.ts, lib/site-data/kinds.ts), >= 1.37.0 (the legal seam, as 1.0.0). No site_data requires are declared: every kind is optional and an absent file is the empty state. In 1.0.0 the LEGAL pages only. Ray, 2026-09-10: "supa has no terms pages or about page"; asked where they belong, "legal pages are not in corporate sdk?" and "you should look at the dart side if they are not there yet" - on the Dart side corporate/corporate/dart (corporate_sdk 1.2.0) owns TermPage / PolicyPage at /term and /policy and every composition with auth_sdk includes it, so this half mirrors that ownership: it installs app/legal/page.tsx (the index of the shell's published legal documents) and app/legal/[id]/page.tsx (one document; 404 when missing or disabled), both server components with no "use client" (the first HTML carries the words; generateMetadata takes the document's title through base_sdk's buildPageMetadata), the renderer components/custom/legal/legal-doc.tsx (LegalDoc, normaliseLegalDoc, LegalDocView: title + the body as text with whitespace kept at prose width - the way rokct.ai's hand-rolled app/legal/[id]/page.tsx renders it), the frame components/custom/legal/legal-frame.tsx (the host's PLATFORM_NAME linking home, the content, and base_sdk's FooterChromeRow carrying the Legal link group built from the same documents), the guest read app/actions/corporate/legal.ts getPublicTerm(name) (frappe.client.get on doctype "Terms and Conditions" through base_sdk's platform gateway with no credentials, mirroring rokct.ai's TermsService.getSystemTerm; null with no backend) and the ONE seam the pages read through, components/custom/legal/load-legal-doc.ts: loadLegalDoc(slug) and loadLegalIndex(). The list comes from base_sdk >= 1.37.0's app/actions/base/legal.ts listPublicTerms() and the links from its components/custom/landing/legal-links.ts (legalFooterLinks, legalDocHref, LEGAL_DOCTYPE, LEGAL_ROUTE), so the footer row these pages draw is the row a home SDK's footer draws once it passes FooterChromeConfig.links - base carries the links and the read, this SDK the pages. Composed into every Next.js shell with auth (hosting, supacharge, rokctapp templates in the-rokct-protocol core/utils/frappe/composer), never as the home SDK (home_sdk false). Ray, 2026-09-10 22:14Z: corporate_sdk owns the company pages (legal, about, team) as renderers, with content from the shell's data/ folder on local / hybrid shells - base 1.35.0 adds that server-only reader, and corporate_sdk 1.1.0 adds the about / team pages and the data/ fallback inside loadLegalDoc / loadLegalIndex without touching the pages. No dependencies of its own (react, next and base's installs), no integrations: the routes are file-convention pages. tests/test_manifest.py holds the installs, the floors, that every entry module is directive-free, that the document page 404s a missing or disabled document, and that nothing rendered carries placeholder words.
_comment.app/actions/base/legal.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.45.0 (listPublicTerms(), the guest read of every enabled "Terms and Conditions" document that loadLegalIndex() and the footer's Legal row are built from; since base 1.45.0 it answers the shell's bundled data/legal slugs when the backend publishes nothing, the rule load-legal-doc.ts's bundledLegalDoc mirrors per slug since 1.2.0 - against 1.37.0-1.44.0 the index would list nothing where this SDK's document page now answers)
_comment.app/config/platform.ts: host shell (PLATFORM_NAME, the name the legal frame's home link shows; never written here)
_comment.app/lib/site-metadata.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.20.0 (buildPageMetadata, the page-scope metadata builder generateMetadata hands the document's title to)
_comment.app/services/base/platform-gateway.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.3.0 (platformCall with requireAuth false, the guest gateway read getPublicTerm makes; since 1.1.0 also resolveTenantBaseUrl, which load-legal-doc.ts asks to tell a shell with no backend from one with, before it reads data/legal)

_comment.lib/site-data/read-site-data.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.35.0 (readSiteData, hasSiteData, siteDataMode - the server-only reader of the shell's data/ folder the about, team and legal renderers read through)
